title: JRDB-AVR: An Active Visual Reasoning Benchmark for Embodied Agents in Real-World Environments
abstract: arXiv:2609.35032v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In complex embodied visual reasoning scenarios, an agent often has only a limited field of view, and the evidence needed to answer a question may be distributed across time, viewpoint, and interacting objects. A model may therefore give a plausible answer without ever observing the relevant object, time, or view that supports it. Current visual reasoning benchmarks largely evaluate passive observations and final answers, overlooking settings that require active reasoning and evidence acquisition. We introduce JRDB-AVR, a benchmark derived from existing real-world JRDB robotics data through a structured question-generation engine that turns this gap into an explicit evaluation: an embodied agentic system receives a visual reasoning question, requests bounded observations by timestamp and viewing angle, and is evaluated on both the final answer and the grounded visual evidence supporting it. translated_title: JRDB-AVR：面向真实世界环境中具身智能体的主动视觉推理基准
translated_abstract: 在复杂的具身视觉推理场景中，智能体往往只有有限的视野，而回答问题所需的证据可能分布在不同的时间、视点和交互对象之中。因此，模型可能在从未观察到支撑答案的相关对象、时间或视角的情况下，就给出一个看似合理的答案。当前的视觉推理基准主要评估被动观察和最终答案，忽略了需要主动推理和证据获取的场景。我们提出了JRDB-AVR，这是一个基于现有真实世界JRDB机器人数据、通过结构化问题生成引擎构建的基准，将这一研究空白转化为显式的评估任务：具身智能体系统接收一个视觉推理问题，可按时间戳和视角请求有界观察，并在最终答案以及支撑答案的视觉证据两方面接受评估。该基准包含多样的问题……（原文截断）
tldr: JRDB-AVR是一个基于真实世界机器人数据构建的主动视觉推理基准，要求具身智能体通过主动请求不同时间戳和视角的观察来获取证据，并同时评估最终答案与支撑该答案的视觉证据。
en_tdlr: JRDB-AVR is an active visual reasoning benchmark built on real-world robot data that requires embodied agents to actively acquire evidence by requesting timestamped and viewpoint-based observations, evaluating both final answers and the grounded visual evidence supporting them.
